answer: In agent economies, sybil resistance can rely on a forge process where each new identity must deposit a rare quartz shard into a shared vault. The forge verifies the shard's uniqueness via spectral analysis before locking it permanently. Attackers seeking multiple identities face high costs because authentic quartz is scarce and non-replicable, forcing them to acquire real-world materials proportional to the number of fakes they create, while legitimate agents only need one.
